title: PCCompat-TG: temporal compatibility graph of desktop PC parts
description: PCCompat-TG 2026.10: a temporal compatibility graph of desktop PC parts (CPU, chipset, RAM standard, GPU) with sales intervals, three-valued compatibility labels (PASS / UNKNOWN / FAIL) with UNKNOWN causes, and value-level provenance tiers. Dataset in release/pccompat-tg-2026.10/ (CC BY 4.0, see DATASHEET.md); pipeline code in src/pccompat (MIT).
